text_en: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered:
text_cn: 叔亚人彼耳达得发言说：

text_en: “How long will you say these things, and the words of your mouth be a great wind?
text_cn: 这些话你要讲到几时？你口中的话像狂风要到何时？

text_en: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert the right?
text_cn: 天主岂能违背公道？全能者岂能屈枉正义？

text_en: If your children sinned against him, he delivered them into the power of their transgression.
text_cn: 若你的子女得罪了他，他必将他们交于罪过的权势下。

text_en: If you will seek God and make supplication to the Almighty,
text_cn: 你若急切寻觅天主，哀求全能者；

text_en: if you are pure and upright, surely then he will rouse himself for you and restore to you your rightful place.
text_cn: 你若纯洁正直，他必亲来守护你，恢复你正义的居所。

text_en: Though your beginning was small, your latter days will be very great.
text_cn: 你起初虽然微小，今后必要兴隆强大。

text_en: “For inquire now of bygone generations, and consider what their ancestors have found;
text_cn: 请你查问上一代，细想祖先的经验；

text_en: for we are but of yesterday, and we know nothing, for our days on earth are but a shadow.
text_cn: 因为我们由昨日才有，本来一无所知；我们在世上的日月，好似影子。

text_en: Will they not teach you and tell you and utter words out of their understanding?
text_cn: 他们必训诫你，指教你，向你说出内心的话：

text_en: “Can papyrus grow where there is no marsh? Can reeds flourish where there is no water?
text_cn: 蒲草不在池沼内，怎能长大？芦苇没有水，怎会长起？

text_en: While yet in flower and not cut down, they wither before any other plant.
text_cn: 在茁壮中，尚未砍下，已先百草而枯萎。

text_en: Such are the paths of all who forget God; the hope of the godless shall perish.
text_cn: 凡忘记天主的，他的末路也是这样：恶人的希望必化为泡影。

text_en: Their confidence is gossamer, a spider’s house their trust.
text_cn: 他的依靠好似游丝，他的凭藉有如蛛网。

text_en: If one leans against its house, it will not stand; if one lays hold of it, it will not endure.
text_cn: 他倚恃自己的家，但它却站立不住；他要依附自己的住所，住所却不能久存。

text_en: The wicked thrive before the sun, and their shoots spread over the garden.
text_cn: 它在日光下而青葱，枝蔓爬满了园囿，

text_en: Their roots twine around the stoneheap; they live among the rocks.
text_cn: 根盘据在石堆上，缠绕在石屋上。

text_en: If they are destroyed from their place, then it will deny them, saying, ‘I have never seen you. ’
text_cn: 若有人从原处把它拔除，那地必否认说：“我未曾见过它。”

text_en: See, these are their happy ways, and out of the earth still others will spring.
text_cn: 看，它要腐烂在路上，必从地上生出另一棵。

text_en: “See, God will not reject a blameless person, nor take the hand of evildoers.
text_cn: 天主决不弃舍完善的人，也决不支持恶人的势力。

text_en: He will yet fill your mouth with laughter, and your lips with shouts of joy.
text_cn: 你的口角必再洋溢着喜悦，你的唇边必再充满欢笑。

text_en: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame, and the tent of the wicked will be no more. ”
text_cn: 憎恨你的必蒙受羞辱，恶人的帐幕必化为乌有。
